name: wmtiles
description: Pure-TypeScript reader for the WMTiles single-file format. Parses headers, snapshots, block tables; decodes per-tile codecs; dequantizes per-block. No DOM dependency: works in browsers, Node, Bun, Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.build: bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/format.ts --outfile dist/format.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/decoder.ts --outfile dist/decoder.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/tileid.ts --outfile dist/tileid.cjs --target node --format cjs && bun build src/errors.ts --outfile dist/errors.cjs --target node --format cjs
